source_title: Docker Compose — Spring Boot with MySQL

cleaned_entries.title: Spring Boot + MySQL Docker Compose
cleaned_entries.content:
Spring Boot + MySQL Docker Compose

Compose pattern for Spring Boot backend (port 8080) with MySQL 8.0 database (port 3306). Both services receive MYSQL_DATABASE, MYSQL_USER, MYSQL_PASSWORD, MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD from environment. Backend depends_on db.

Decision rules:
- Use when language=java, framework=spring_boot, dependencies include mysql
- MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD is required for MySQL 8.0 container initialization even when a regular user is defined

Trade-offs:
- No persistent volume — MySQL data is lost on container removal; add a named volume for durability
- No healthcheck on db — Spring Boot may attempt JDBC connections before MySQL is accepting them

Anti-patterns:
- Do not hardcode MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD or MYSQL_PASSWORD in the compose file
- Do not expose port 3306 to 0.0.0.0 in internet-facing environments
